classification.difficultyReason: Students use the table to link annual percentage calculations with updated balances, then select subtraction of the original principal to distinguish interest earned from the final balance.

content.prompt: $\$3600$ is invested at 5% p.a. compound interest for 3 years.

inlines.text: Complete the table to find the final value at the end of 3 years. Keep full precision in intermediate calculations and round the final value to 2 decimal places.
Each ending balance becomes the next starting balance. Interest = starting balance × 5%. Display amounts to cents and retain unrounded values in intermediate calculations.
